7084-7889-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4691-5165-6331.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4691-5165-6331.description:
Donate control of Vilis to an opponent using Stiltzkin
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-2608-3899-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2608-3899-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

1563-2433-2762-4321.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Rosie Cotton triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and another +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1115-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1069-3552-5434-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5434-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1824-2530-4668-7351.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4668-7351.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1824-2530-4668-7351.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Prism Ring triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-7296--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-7296--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-7296--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

233-2645-3688-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {B} as it's a Swamp land due to Toph and Urborg
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3622-4067-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
3622-4067-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gravedigger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Gravedigger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Gravedigger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

1978-3263-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
1978-3263-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat

3609-5471-6807.notablePrerequisites: Obeka cannot be blocked by an opponent
3609-5471-6807.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Vedalken Infuser triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka, triggering Obeka, causing you to get two additional upkeep steps after this one.
Repeat step 1 during each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

338-2060-3490-3910-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3490-3910-6753.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-5134-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Fated Infatuation
2743-5134-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Fated Infatuation twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Fated Infatuations, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

722-3153-6558.notablePrerequisites: Naga Fleshcrafter is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-6558.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

186-2060-3129-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-3129-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2092-4499-5418.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4499-5418.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Exhibition Magician.
When Exhibition Magician enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-5870.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-5870.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

997-1887-3305-4022-5926.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

2438-4089-5011.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

116-1603-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Evil Twin is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Evil Twin do not have summoning sickness.
116-1603-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Evil Twin.
Activate Evil Twin by tapping it.
When Evil Twin becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Evil Twin's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1655-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Ninja of the Deep Hours does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
1655-2792-3489.description:
Declare Ninja of the Deep Hours as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Ninja of the Deep Hours from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ninja of the Deep Hours's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ninja of the Deep Hours onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

277-835-1737-2544-4893.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Tanglepool Bridge.
When Tanglepool Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Tanglepool Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

3156-3558-3652-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
3156-3558-3652-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Ornithopter.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

917-3384-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
917-3384-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.

865-2429-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten in any combination of Treasures and/or creatures.
865-2429-4050.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Mahadi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 2 until you control no creatures.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token for each creature that died this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.

4112-4242-4499-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

708-2034-2459-4753.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2034-2459-4753.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

3179-3676-3917-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Activate Orochi Leafcaller by paying {G}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
